name: Occultist Academy
source:
Something must've gone wrong with the paperwork – as you miss your enrollment as a student, and find yourself quarantined in the basement along with other first years. Except, instead of a dorm, you're on a sacrificial altar!

As you explore and learn more about your situation, you're faced with a decision: will you be sacrificed, escape, or join them?

[From [url=https://lezbianesthere.itch.io/occultist-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
文书工作肯定出了问题——因为你错过了学生注册，并发现自己和其他一年级新生一起被隔离在地下室。只不过，你不是在宿舍，而是在祭坛上！

当你探索并更多地了解自己的处境时，你面临着一个决定：你会被牺牲、逃跑还是加入他们？

[来自[url=https://lezbianesthere.itch.io/occultist-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
